declarations.docstring: Associates an auxiliary integer to each partition.
Views an element of a monoid algebra as its coefficient function.
Returns an auxiliary element indexed by a natural number.
The auxiliary element commutes with every element of the indexed family.
On members of the partition-indexed collection, multiplication by the auxiliary element equals scalar multiplication by the associated integer.
Multiplication by the auxiliary element on the partition-indexed element equals scalar multiplication by the associated integer.
For distinct indices, the coefficient at their swap is the difference of the two equality indicators determined by the partition data.
